verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing is an invoicing and billing SaaS, not an AI agent or assistant host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools falls outside its product role. The documented Stripe MCP server (docs-21, probe-4) is server-side: it lets external agents call the Stripe API. It does not show the product plugging in MCP servers, so it is not credited here.
